description: TU Delft and municipal project partners publish six four-point bending experiments on spruce piles recovered from an Overamstel quay wall. The provider describes forces, deflections, fibre-optic strain observations and micro-drilling measurements of decayed outer timber. The 2022 experimental evidence characterises mechanical behaviour of historic quay-wall foundation piles. Coverage: 2022 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: Excel spreadsheets, plain-text files and PDF guides. Licence: CC0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The limited specimen series is not a city-wide condition survey; measurement files and failure interpretations were not independently checked. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
